moments.text: Grey IR view looking down at a rocky ridge with a crosshair and black masking boxes; a disclosure notice runs along the bottom.
The view switches to colour: the same sandy ridge in pinkish tones, with a dark channel sliding in at the top from 7.4 s.
A tiny dark speck crosses from upper right of the crosshair, past it, to the lower left in about 1 s. Faint; use frame step.
Quick flips between grey and colour, then the grey view settles and the ridge edge slides off to the upper left.
Plain grey ground with faint streaks. A tiny dark dot appears upper right near 18 s and drifts in to just above the crosshair.
Colour view again: the dark dot sits far left of the crosshair at 27.6 s and is gone off the left edge by 28.5 s.
Back to grey with diagonal streaks across the ground; the dark dot reappears low on the left, below left of the crosshair.
Colour view of plain ground: the dot sits far left near 52 s, just left of the crosshair by 62 s, then drifts upper left.
Grey view again with bright patches lower left; the dark dot sits upper left of the crosshair.
A dark channel with bright, bumpy banks sweeps across the frame from left to right as the view pans.
Grey streaky ground; the dark dot shows right of the crosshair near 90 s and next to it by 98 s.
The view switches to colour for the last 5 seconds over plain ground.
